results.content:
Three devices are expected in September: the iPhone 18 Pro, the iPhone 18 Pro Max and the iPhone Fold, Apple’s first foldable phone. The standard iPhone 18 follows months later in spring 2027.

Tom’s Guide reported that Apple is expected to launch up to eight different devices at its September event, including new Apple Watches and smart home products. The event will be hosted by John Ternus, who is taking the reins as Apple’s new CEO.
